page.content:
February 1945 meeting of Roosevelt, Churchill, and Stalin.

How Yalta Conference connects

  • Character: Joseph Stalin — Stalin bargained occupation and the UN at Yalta.
  • Faction: United Nations — Yalta locked in big-power voting that shaped the UN Security Council.

What is Yalta Conference?

Yalta settled occupation zones in Germany, Polish borders in outline, and Soviet entry against Japan — bargains that framed the early Cold War as well as the UN founding votes.

Key threads lead to Joseph Stalin and United Nations.
